title.zh: 卷十八 本紀第十八 世宗二
title.raw: 卷十八 本紀第十八 世宗二 Volume 18 Annals 18: Shizong 2

sentences.zh: 【世宗二】

translations.literal: Shizong II.
translations.idiomatic: Annals: Shizong II.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月丙午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, spring, first month, day bingwu new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Jiajing twenty-two, on the bingwu new moon of the first month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，復遣使采木湖廣。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengxu: envoys were again dispatched to gather timber in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengxu, the court again sent envoys to gather timber in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 是春，俺答屢入塞。

translations.literal: That spring, Anda repeatedly entered the passes.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Anda raided across the frontier again and again.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，犯延綏，總兵官吳瑛等擊敗之。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month: he invaded Yan-sui; Regional Commander Wu Ying and others defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, Anda invaded Yan-sui and was defeated by Regional Commander Wu Ying and others.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，朵顏入寇，殺守備陳舜。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Duoyan invaded, killing Garrison Commander Chen Shun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Duoyan invaded and killed Garrison Commander Chen Shun.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，免南畿被災稅糧。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yiyou: tax grain in disaster-stricken Southern Metropolitan Region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiyou, tax grain was forgiven in the disaster-hit Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、土魯番、撒馬兒罕、天方、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Turpan, Samarkand, Tianfang, and U-Tsang entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Champa, Turpan, Samarkand, Tianfang, and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月丙寅，俺答犯黃崖口。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, spring, first month, day bingyin: Anda invaded Huangyakou.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Jiajing twenty-three, on bingyin of the first month, Anda invaded Huangyakou.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，犯大水谷。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuyin: he invaded Dashuigu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuyin, he invaded Dashuigu.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑，犯龍門所。

translations.literal: Third month, day guichou: he invaded Longmen Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guichou, he invaded Longmen Garrison.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賜秦鳴雷等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: jinshi titles, palace degrees, and various provincial degrees were granted to Qin Minglei and others.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the palace examination was held; Qin Minglei and others received jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，俺答犯大同，總兵官周尚文戰於黑山，敗之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Anda invaded Datong; Regional Commander Zhou Shangwen fought at Heishan and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Anda invaded Datong; Regional Commander Zhou Shangwen fought him at Heishan and won.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，翟鑾罷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiawu: Zhai Luan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiawu, Zhai Luan was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，免浙江被災稅糧。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guimao: tax grain in disaster-stricken Zhejiang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，吏部尚書許贊兼文淵閣大學士，禮部尚書張璧兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Minister of Personnel Xu Zan was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion, and Minister of Rites Zhang Bi was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion; both joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Xu Zan, minister of personnel, was also made grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion, and Zhang Bi, minister of rites, was also made grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion; both entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 壬子，振湖廣災。

translations.literal: Day renzi: disaster relief was extended in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the court sent disaster relief to Huguang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，免河南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuchen: tax grain in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuchen, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Henan.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，小王子入萬全右衛。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the Little Prince entered Wanquan Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Little Prince entered Wanquan Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，掠蔚州，至於完縣。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: he plundered Weizhou, reaching as far as Wanxian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he plundered Weizhou and pushed as far as Wanxian.

sentences.zh: 京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: The capital was placed on military alert.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing was placed under martial law.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，逮總督宣大兵部尚書翟鵬、巡撫薊鎮僉都御史硃方下獄，鵬謫戍，方杖死。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Grand Coordinator of Xuanda, Minister of War Zhai Peng, and Grand Coordinator of Jizhen, Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhu Fang, were arrested and imprisoned; Peng was demoted to frontier service, Fang was beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Grand Coordinator of Xuanda and Minister of War Zhai Peng and Grand Coordinator of Jizhen Zhu Fang were thrown into prison; Peng was banished to frontier service and Fang was beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，京師解嚴。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengzi: the capital was relieved of military alert.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengzi, martial law in the capital was lifted.

sentences.zh: 加方士陶仲文少師。

translations.literal: The Daoist adept Tao Zhongwen was promoted to Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Zhongwen, a court Daoist adept, was given the rank of junior preceptor.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，振江西災。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingzi: disaster relief was extended in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingzi, the court sent disaster relief to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南入貢，日本以無表卻之。

translations.literal: That year, Annam entered with tribute; Japan was refused because it sent no memorial of submission.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam sent tribute; Japan was turned away for presenting no formal memorial of submission.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春二月戊申，詔流民復業，予牛種，開墾閒田者給復十年。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, spring, second month, day wushen: an edict ordered wandering people to return to their occupations, granted cattle and seed, and gave ten years' remission to those who opened and cleared idle land.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Jiajing twenty-four, on wushen of the second month, an edict urged displaced peasants back to their fields, supplied them with oxen and seed, and granted ten years' tax remission to those who reclaimed wasteland.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，逮總督宣大兵部侍郎張漢下獄，謫戍。

translations.literal: Third month, day renwu: Grand Coordinator of Xuanda, Vice Minister of War Zhang Han, was arrested and imprisoned and demoted to frontier service.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renwu, Grand Coordinator of Xuanda Zhang Han, vice minister of war, was arrested, imprisoned, and banished to frontier service.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day renxu new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the renxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，太廟成。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renchen: the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renchen, the Imperial Ancestral Temple was finished.

sentences.zh: 是夏，免畿輔、山西、陝西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That summer, tax grain in disaster-stricken metropolitan suburbs, Shanxi, and Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That summer tax grain was forgiven in the disaster-hit metropolitan suburbs, Shanxi, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 秋七秋壬戌，有事於太廟，赦徒罪以下。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renxu: rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; convict offenses and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renxu, the court sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and proclaimed a general amnesty down to convict offenses.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，瘞暴骸。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingwu: unburied corpses were interred.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingwu, the court ordered the burial of exposed corpses.

sentences.zh: 己酉，張璧卒。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Zhang Bi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Zhang Bi died.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，俺答犯松子嶺，殺守備張文瀚。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Anda invaded Songziling, killing Garrison Commander Zhang Wenhan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Anda invaded Songziling and killed Garrison Commander Zhang Wenhan.

sentences.zh: 是月，犯大同，參將張鳳、指揮劉欽等戰死。

translations.literal: That month, he invaded Datong; Assistant Regional Commander Zhang Feng, Commander Liu Qin, and others died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: That month he invaded Datong; Assistant Regional Commander Zhang Feng, Commander Liu Qin, and others were killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，召夏言入閣。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingchou: Xia Yan was summoned to enter the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingchou, Xia Yan was recalled to the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛巳，許贊罷。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day xinsi: Xu Zan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on xinsi, Xu Zan was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、琉球、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annam, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春三月戊辰，四川白草番亂。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, spring, third month, day wuchen: the Baicao tribes rebelled in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Jiajing twenty-five, on wuchen of the third month, the Baicao tribes rose in rebellion in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊辰，俺答款大同塞，邊將殺其使。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day wuchen: Anda sought peace at the Datong frontier; frontier generals killed his envoys.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on wuchen, Anda sued for peace at the Datong frontier and frontier generals killed his envoys.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，犯宣府，千戶汪洪戰死。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: he invaded Xuanfu; Battalion Commander Wang Hong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiachen, he invaded Xuanfu and Battalion Commander Wang Hong was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，以醴泉出承華殿，廷臣表賀，停諸司封事二十日。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiyou: because an auspicious spring appeared at Chenghua Hall, court officials presented congratulatory memorials; sealed memorials from all offices were halted for twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiyou, a sweet spring appeared at Chenghua Hall; court officials submitted congratulatory memorials, and sealed memorials from all offices were suspended for twenty days.

sentences.zh: 嗣後，慶賀齋祀悉停封奏。

translations.literal: Thereafter, congratulatory memorials and fasting-sacrifice memorials were all halted.
translations.idiomatic: After that, congratulatory and fasting-sacrifice memorials were suspended altogether.

sentences.zh: 是月，俺答犯延安、慶陽。

translations.literal: That month, Anda invaded Yan'an and Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Anda invaded Yan'an and Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，免山東被災稅糧。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renzi: tax grain in disaster-stricken Shandong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renzi, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Shandong.

sentences.zh: 九月，俺答犯寧夏。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Anda invaded Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Anda invaded Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，犯清平堡，遊擊高極戰死。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dinghai: he invaded Qingping Fort; Mobile Corps Commander Gao Ji died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dinghai, he invaded Qingping Fort and Mobile Corps Commander Gao Ji was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，代府奉國將軍充灼謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Fengguo General of the Dai princely establishment Chong Zhuo plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Fengguo General Chong Zhuo of the Dai princely establishment plotted rebellion and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 甲午，殺故建昌侯張延齡。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the former Marquis of Jianchang Zhang Yanling was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the former Marquis of Jianchang Zhang Yanling was executed.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，免河南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingwei: tax grain in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingwei, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Henan.

sentences.zh: 是年，土魯番入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Turpan entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Turpan sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春三月庚午，賜李春芳等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, spring, third month, day gengwu: jinshi titles, palace degrees, and various provincial degrees were granted to Li Chunfang and others.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Jiajing twenty-six, on gengwu of the third month, Li Chunfang and others received jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，巡撫四川都御史張時徹、副總兵何卿討平白草叛番。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yisi: Grand Coordinator of Sichuan Censor-in-Chief Zhang Shiche and Vice Regional Commander He Qing suppressed the Baicao rebel tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yisi, Grand Coordinator of Sichuan Zhang Shiche and Vice Regional Commander He Qing put down the Baicao rebels.

sentences.zh: 己酉，俺答求貢，拒之。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Anda sought to present tribute; the request was refused.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Anda asked to send tribute; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，河決曹縣。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingchen: the Yellow River breached at Caoxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingchen, the Yellow River broke its banks at Caoxian.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，免陝西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingxu: tax grain in disaster-stricken Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingxu, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，戶部尚書王杲以科臣劾其通賄下獄，遣戍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuchen: Minister of Revenue Wang Gao, impeached by censorial officials for taking bribes, was imprisoned and sent to frontier service.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuchen, Minister of Revenue Wang Gao was impeached by censorial officials for bribery, cast into prison, and banished to frontier service.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙午，振成都饑。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day bingwu: famine relief was extended in Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on bingwu, the court sent famine relief to Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬午，大內火，釋楊爵於獄。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day renwu: fire broke out in the Inner Palace; Yang Jue was released from prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on renwu, fire broke out in the Inner Palace and Yang Jue was released from prison.

sentences.zh: 乙未，皇后崩。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the empress died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the empress died.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，逮甘肅總兵官仇鸞。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinyou: Regional Commander of Gansu Qiu Luan was arrested.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, Regional Commander of Gansu Qiu Luan was arrested.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，海寇犯寧波、台州。

translations.literal: Day yihai: sea bandits invaded Ningbo and Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai sea bandits raided Ningbo and Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月，把都兒寇廣甯，參將閻振戰死。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, spring, first month: Batu raided Guangning; Assistant Regional Commander Yan Zhen died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Jiajing twenty-seven, in the first month, Batu raided Guangning and Assistant Regional Commander Yan Zhen was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以議復河套，逮總督陝西三邊侍郎曾銑，杖給事中御史於廷。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: because of deliberations on recovering the Ordos, Grand Coordinator of the Shaanxi Three Frontiers, Vice Minister Zeng Xian, was arrested; supervising secretaries and censors were beaten at court.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, amid debate over recovering the Ordos, Grand Coordinator of the Shaanxi Three Frontiers Zeng Xian was arrested and supervising secretaries and censors were beaten in open court.

sentences.zh: 罷夏言。

translations.literal: Xia Yan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Yan was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，殺曾銑，逮夏言。

translations.literal: Third month, day guisi: Zeng Xian was executed; Xia Yan was arrested.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guisi, Zeng Xian was executed and Xia Yan was arrested.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，出仇鸞於獄。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Qiu Luan was released from prison.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Qiu Luan was released from prison.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙戌，葬孝烈皇后。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day bingxu: Empress Xiaolie was buried.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on bingxu, Empress Xiaolie was buried.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，京師地震。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuyin: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuyin, an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚子，西苑進嘉谷，薦於太廟。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: auspicious grain was presented from the Western Park and offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi auspicious grain from the Western Park was presented and offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，俺答犯大同，指揮顧相等戰死，周尚文追敗之於次野口。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingsi: Anda invaded Datong; Commander Gu Xiang and others died in battle; Zhou Shangwen pursued and defeated him at Ciyekou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingsi, Anda invaded Datong; Commander Gu Xiang and others were killed in battle, and Zhou Shangwen pursued and defeated him at Ciyekou.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，犯宣府，深入永寧、懷來、隆慶，守備魯承恩等戰死。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renwu: he invaded Xuanfu, penetrating deeply into Yongning, Huailai, and Longqing; Garrison Commander Lu Chengen and others died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renwu, he invaded Xuanfu and pushed deep into Yongning, Huailai, and Longqing; Garrison Commander Lu Chengen and others were killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 乙未，免陝西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: tax grain in disaster-stricken Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，殺夏言。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guimao: Xia Yan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guimao, Xia Yan was put to death.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，詔撫按官采生沙金。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiwei: an edict ordered grand coordinators and regional inspectors to gather live alluvial gold.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiwei, an edict directed grand coordinators and regional inspectors to collect raw placer gold.

sentences.zh: 是年，日本入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Japan entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Japan sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春三月壬午，賜唐汝楫等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, spring, third month, day renwu: jinshi titles, palace degrees, and various provincial degrees were granted to Tang Ruji and others.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Jiajing twenty-nine, on renwu of the third month, Tang Ruji and others received jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.

sentences.zh: 是月，瓊州黎賊平。

translations.literal: That month, the Li bandits of Qiongzhou were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Li rebels of Qiongzhou were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 夏六月丁巳，俺答犯大同，總兵官張達、副總兵林椿戰死。

translations.literal: Summer, sixth month, day dingsi: Anda invaded Datong; Regional Commander Zhang Da and Vice Regional Commander Lin Chun died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on dingsi, Anda invaded Datong; Regional Commander Zhang Da and Vice Regional Commander Lin Chun were killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 是夏，免陝西、河南、江北被災夏稅。

translations.literal: That summer, summer tax in disaster-stricken Shaanxi, Henan, and Jiangbei was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That summer summer tax was forgiven in disaster-stricken Shaanxi, Henan, and Jiangbei.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丙寅，封方士陶仲文為恭誠伯。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day bingyin: the Daoist adept Tao Zhongwen was enfeoffed as Baron of Gongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on bingyin, court Daoist adept Tao Zhongwen was enfeoffed as Baron of Gongcheng.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，俺答大舉入寇，攻古北口，薊鎮兵潰。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Anda mounted a large invasion, attacking Gubeikou; the Jizhen garrison collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Anda launched a major invasion, assaulted Gubeikou, and routed the Jizhen garrison.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，掠通州，駐白河，分掠畿甸州縣，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: he plundered Tongzhou, encamped at Baihe, sent detachments to plunder prefectures and counties in the metropolitan districts; the capital was placed on military alert.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he plundered Tongzhou, camped at Baihe, and sent detachments to raid prefectures and counties around the capital; Beijing was placed under martial law.

sentences.zh: 召大同總兵官仇鸞及河南、山東兵入援。

translations.literal: Regional Commander of Datong Qiu Luan and troops from Henan and Shandong were summoned to reinforce the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Luan, regional commander of Datong, and troops from Henan and Shandong were called in to relieve the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，薄都城。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the raiders approached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the raiders drew near the capital.

sentences.zh: 仇鸞為平虜大將軍，節制諸路兵馬，巡撫保定都御史楊守謙提督軍務，左諭德趙貞吉宣諭諸軍。

translations.literal: Qiu Luan was made General Who Pacifies the Barbarians with authority over all route armies; Grand Coordinator of Baoding Censor-in-Chief Yang Shouqian directed military affairs; Left Lecturer Zhao Zhenji announced the imperial will to the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu Luan was appointed General Who Pacifies the Barbarians with command over all route armies; Grand Coordinator of Baoding Yang Shouqian took charge of military affairs; and Left Lecturer Zhao Zhenji proclaimed the imperial will to the troops.

sentences.zh: 癸未，始禦奉天殿，戒敕群臣。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: the emperor first held audience at the Hall of Upholding Heaven and issued admonitions to the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the emperor held his first audience at the Hall of Upholding Heaven and issued stern admonitions to the ministers.

sentences.zh: 甲申，寇退。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the raiders withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the raiders withdrew.

sentences.zh: 逮守通州都御史王儀。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Wang Yi, charged with defending Tongzhou, was arrested.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yi, censor-in-chief responsible for Tongzhou's defense, was arrested.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，京師解嚴。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the capital was relieved of military alert.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu martial law in the capital was lifted.

sentences.zh: 杖趙貞吉，謫外任。

translations.literal: Zhao Zhenji was beaten with the staff and demoted to an outside post.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zhenji was beaten with the staff and banished to an outside appointment.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，仇鸞敗績于白羊口。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Qiu Luan suffered defeat at Baiyangkou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Qiu Luan was defeated at Baiyangkou.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書丁汝夔、巡撫侍郎楊守謙有罪，棄市。

translations.literal: Minister of War Ding Ruqie and Grand Coordinator Vice Minister Yang Shouqian were found guilty and executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Ding Ruqie and Grand Coordinator Yang Shouqian were found guilty and executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 杖左都御史屠僑、刑部侍郎彭黯。

translations.literal: Left Censor-in-Chief Tu Qiao and Vice Minister of Justice Peng An were beaten with the staff.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Qiao, left censor-in-chief, and Peng An, vice minister of justice, were flogged at court.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，振畿內被寇者。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinmao: relief was extended to those within the metropolitan region harmed by the raid.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinmao, the court sent relief to those in the metropolitan region harmed by the raid.

sentences.zh: 乙未，罷團營，復三大營舊制，設戎政府，以仇鸞總督之。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the Corps Camps were abolished and the old system of Three Great Camps restored; a Military Affairs Bureau was established, with Qiu Luan as its director-general.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the Corps Camps were abolished, the old Three Great Camps system was restored, a Military Affairs Bureau was set up, and Qiu Luan was made its director-general.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，罷領營中官。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: eunuchs leading the camps were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the eunuchs who commanded the camps were removed from their posts.

sentences.zh: 戊申，免畿內被災稅糧。

translations.literal: Day wushen: tax grain in disaster-stricken areas within the metropolitan region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken areas within the metropolitan region.

sentences.zh: 壬子，廢鄭王厚烷為庶人。

translations.literal: On renzi, Prince of Zheng Hou Yan was deposed and demoted to commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Prince of Zheng Hou Yan was stripped of his title and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，張治卒。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiaxu, Zhang Zhi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiaxu, Zhang Zhi died.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，分遣御史選邊軍入衛。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on guisi, censors were dispatched separately to select frontier troops for capital garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guisi, censors were sent out separately to select frontier troops for service in the capital garrison.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，祧仁宗，祔孝烈皇后于太廟。

translations.literal: On renyin, Emperor Renzong was removed from the main line of the ancestral temple, and Empress Xiaolie was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Emperor Renzong was removed from the main line of the ancestral temple, and Empress Xiaolie was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 三十年春三月壬辰，開馬市于宣府、大同，兵部侍郎史道經理之。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year, spring, third month, on renchen, horse markets were opened at Xuanfu and Datong, managed by Vice Minister of War Shi Dao.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of spring in the thirtieth year, on renchen, horse markets were opened at Xuanfu and Datong under the supervision of Vice Minister of War Shi Dao.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，下經略京城副都御史商大節於獄。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renwu, Vice Censor-in-Chief Shang Dajie, Commissioner for Capital Defense, was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renwu, Vice Censor-in-Chief Shang Dajie, commissioner for capital defense, was cast into prison.

sentences.zh: 秋九月乙未，京師地震，詔修省。

translations.literal: Autumn, ninth month, on yiwei, the capital was shaken by earthquake; an edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on yiwei, an earthquake struck the capital, and an edict ordered the court to examine its conduct and reform.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，俺答犯大同。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, Anda invaded Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, Anda invaded Datong.

sentences.zh: 是年，免兩畿、河南、江西、遼東、貴州、山東、山西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That year taxes and grain levies were remitted in disaster-stricken regions of the two metropolitan circuits, Henan, Jiangxi, Liaodong, Guizhou, Shandong, and Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That year taxes and grain levies were forgiven in disaster-stricken regions of the two metropolitan circuits, Henan, Jiangxi, Liaodong, Guizhou, Shandong, and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 三十一年春正月壬辰，俺答犯大同。

translations.literal: Thirty-first year, spring, first month, on renchen, Anda invaded Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the thirty-first year, on renchen, Anda invaded Datong.

sentences.zh: 甲午，入弘賜堡。

translations.literal: On jiawu he entered Hongci Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he broke into Hongci Fort.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，振宣、大饑。

translations.literal: Second month, on guichou, famine relief was extended to Xuanfu and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guichou, famine relief was sent to Xuanfu and Datong.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，俺答犯懷仁川，指揮僉事王恭戰死。

translations.literal: On xinyou Anda invaded Huairen Stream; Commander Wang Gong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Anda struck Huairen Stream, and Commander Wang Gong was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 己巳，建內府營，操練內侍。

translations.literal: On jisi the Inner Palace Camp was established to drill eunuch attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Inner Palace Camp was established to train eunuch attendants.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，大將軍仇鸞帥師赴大同。

translations.literal: Third month, on wuzi, Great General Qiu Luan led troops to Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi, Great General Qiu Luan marched to Datong at the head of the army.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，禮部尚書徐階兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: On xinmao Xu Jie, Minister of Rites, was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Eastern Lodge and joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Xu Jie, minister of rites, was also made grand secretary of the Eastern Lodge and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，把都兒、辛愛犯新興堡，指揮王相等戰死。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingyin, Batu and Xin Ai invaded Xinxing Fort; Commander Wang Xiang and others died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingyin, Batu and Xin Ai attacked Xinxing Fort, and Commander Wang Xiang and others were killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 丙子，倭寇浙江。

translations.literal: On bingzi Japanese pirates raided Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Japanese pirates struck Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，召仇鸞還。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jiashen, Qiu Luan was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiashen, Qiu Luan was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 戊申，倭陷黃岩。

translations.literal: On wushen the Japanese took Huangyan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Japanese overran Huangyan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申，免陝西被災夏稅。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingshen, summer taxes were remitted in disaster-stricken Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingshen, summer taxes were forgiven in disaster-stricken Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以倭警命山東巡撫都御史王忬巡視浙江。

translations.literal: On renyin, because of the Japanese alarm, Grand Coordinator Wang Yu of Shandong was ordered to inspect Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, because of the Japanese alarm, Grand Coordinator Wang Yu of Shandong was ordered to inspect the defenses of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，收仇鸞大將軍印，尋病死。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jiwei, Qiu Luan's seals as Great General were confiscated; soon after he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiwei, Qiu Luan's seals as great general were confiscated, and he soon died of illness.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，戮仇鸞屍，傳首九邊。

translations.literal: On yihai Qiu Luan's corpse was posthumously executed; his head was sent to the nine border regions.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Qiu Luan's corpse was posthumously executed, and his head was sent to the nine border regions.

sentences.zh: 己卯，俺答犯大同，分掠朔、應、山陰、馬邑。

translations.literal: On jimao Anda invaded Datong and plundered by separate routes Shuozhou, Yingzhou, Shanyin, and Mayi.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Anda invaded Datong and sent raiders to plunder Shuozhou, Yingzhou, Shanyin, and Mayi.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，犯山西三關。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on yiyou, he invaded the three passes of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yiyou, he struck the three passes of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，犯寧夏。

translations.literal: On renchen he invaded Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he invaded Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，河決徐州。

translations.literal: On dingyou the Yellow River breached its banks at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the Yellow River burst its banks at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，兵部侍郎蔣應奎、左通政唐國卿以冒邊功杖於廷。

translations.literal: On gengzi Vice Minister of War Jiang Yingkui and Left Vice Commissioner Tang Guoqing were cudgeled at court for falsely claiming frontier merit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Vice Minister of War Jiang Yingkui and Left Vice Commissioner Tang Guoqing were beaten at court for falsely claiming frontier merit.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，罷各邊馬市。

translations.literal: On guimao horse markets on all frontiers were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao horse markets on all frontiers were closed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，兵部尚書趙錦坐仇鸞黨戍邊。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiwei, Minister of War Zhao Jin was exiled to the frontier as a member of Qiu Luan's faction.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei, Minister of War Zhao Jin was exiled to the frontier as an associate of Qiu Luan's faction.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，免江西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: On renxu taxes and grain were remitted in disaster-stricken Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu taxes and grain levies were forgiven in disaster-stricken Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingsi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingsi.

sentences.zh: 光祿少卿馬從謙坐誹謗杖死。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Imperial Household Ma Congqian was cudgeled to death for slander.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Imperial Household Ma Congqian was beaten to death at court for slander.

sentences.zh: 三十二年春正月戊寅朔，日食，陰雲不見。

translations.literal: Thirty-second year, spring, first month, new moon on wuyin: there was a solar eclipse, but clouds obscured it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the thirty-second year, on the new moon of wuyin, there was a solar eclipse, but clouds hid it from view.

sentences.zh: 己卯，侍郎吳鵬振淮、徐水災。

translations.literal: On jimao Vice Minister Wu Peng extended famine relief for flood disasters in the Huai region and Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Vice Minister Wu Peng sent relief for flood disasters in the Huai region and Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，倭犯溫州。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiazi Japanese pirates raided Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiazi, Japanese pirates struck Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，俺答犯宣府，參將史略戰死。

translations.literal: On renshen Anda invaded Xuanfu; Brigade Commander Shi Lue died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Anda invaded Xuanfu, and Brigade Commander Shi Lue was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，振陝西饑。

translations.literal: Third month, on dingchou, famine relief was extended to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingchou, famine relief was sent to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，吉能犯延綏，殺副總兵李梅。

translations.literal: On xinsi Ji Neng invaded Yan-Sui and killed Assistant Regional Commander Li Mei.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Ji Neng invaded Yan-Sui and killed Assistant Regional Commander Li Mei.

sentences.zh: 壬午，兵部侍郎楊博巡邊。

translations.literal: On renwu Vice Minister of War Yang Bo inspected the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Vice Minister of War Yang Bo toured the frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 甲申，振山東饑。

translations.literal: On jiashen famine relief was extended to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen famine relief was sent to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賜陳謹等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On jiawu palace examination graduates including Chen Jin were granted jinshi ranks with distinctions between those who passed at the palace examination and those who passed at the regular examination.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu palace graduates including Chen Jin were granted jinshi honors with distinctions between top-tier and regular passes.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，俺答犯宣府，副總兵郭都戰死。

translations.literal: On jiachen Anda invaded Xuanfu; Assistant Regional Commander Guo Du died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Anda invaded Xuanfu again, and Assistant Regional Commander Guo Du was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 閏三月，海賊汪直糾倭寇瀕海諸郡，至六月始去。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, the pirate Wang Zhi gathered Japanese raiders against the coastal commanderies; they did not withdraw until the sixth month.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month the pirate Wang Zhi rallied Japanese raiders against the coastal commanderies, and they did not withdraw until the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，俺答大舉入寇，犯靈丘、廣昌。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuwu, Anda launched a major invasion, striking Lingqiu and Guangchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuwu, Anda launched a major invasion and struck Lingqiu and Guangchang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，河套諸部犯延綏。

translations.literal: On yichou the Ordos tribes invaded Yan-Sui.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the Ordos tribes invaded Yan-Sui.

sentences.zh: 己巳，俺答犯浮圖峪，遊擊陳鳳、硃玉禦之。

translations.literal: On jisi Anda invaded Futuyu Pass; Mobile Corps Commanders Chen Feng and Zhu Yu resisted him.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Anda invaded Futuyu Pass, and Mobile Corps Commanders Chen Feng and Zhu Yu held him off.

sentences.zh: 庚午，河南賊師尚詔陷歸德及柘城、鹿邑。

translations.literal: On gengwu the Henan bandit Shi Shangzhao took Guide and the counties of Zhecheng and Luyi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the Henan bandit Shi Shangzhao seized Guide and the counties of Zhecheng and Luyi.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，小王子犯赤城。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on bingzi the Little Prince invaded Chicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingzi, the Little Prince invaded Chicheng.

sentences.zh: 丙申，師尚詔攻太康，官軍與戰于鄢陵，敗績。

translations.literal: On bingshen Shi Shangzhao attacked Taikang; government forces fought them at Yanling and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Shi Shangzhao attacked Taikang; government troops fought him at Yanling and were routed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，振山東災，免稅糧。

translations.literal: On wuxu famine relief was extended to Shandong disaster regions, and taxes and grain were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu famine relief was sent to disaster-stricken Shandong, and taxes and grain levies were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，俺答犯廣武，巡撫都御史趙時春敗績，總兵官李淶、參將馮恩等力戰死。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on bingwu, Anda invaded Guangwu; Grand Coordinator Zhao Shichun was defeated; Regional Commander Li Lai, Brigade Commander Feng En, and others fought to the death.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingwu, Anda invaded Guangwu; Grand Coordinator Zhao Shichun was defeated, and Regional Commander Li Lai, Brigade Commander Feng En, and others fought to the death.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以敵退告謝郊廟。

translations.literal: On xinyou thanks were reported to the suburban altars and ancestral temples for the enemy's withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court reported thanks at the suburban altars and ancestral temples for the enemy's withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，振河南、山東饑。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiaxu, famine relief was extended to Henan and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiaxu, famine relief was sent to Henan and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 庚子，師尚詔伏誅，賊平。

translations.literal: On gengzi Shi Shangzhao was executed; the bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Shi Shangzhao was executed, and the rebellion was put down.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，京師外城成。

translations.literal: On xinchou the outer wall of the capital was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the outer wall of the capital was finished.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 三十三年春正月壬寅朔，以賀疏違制，杖六科給事中於廷。

translations.literal: Thirty-third year, spring, first month, new moon on renyin: because congratulatory memorials violated regulations, the six-branch supervising secretaries were cudgeled at court.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the thirty-third year, on the new moon of renyin, the supervising secretaries of the six offices were beaten at court because their congratulatory memorials violated protocol.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，官軍圍倭於南沙，五閱月不克，倭潰圍出，轉掠蘇、松。

translations.literal: On wuchen government forces besieged Japanese pirates at Nansha; after five months they failed to take them, and the Japanese broke out and turned to plunder Suzhou and Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen government forces besieged Japanese pirates at Nansha; after five months they still had not broken the siege, and the Japanese broke out and turned to plunder Suzhou and Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，官軍敗績於松江。

translations.literal: Second month, on gengchen government forces were defeated at Songjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengchen, government forces were defeated at Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，倭犯通、泰，餘眾入青、徐界。

translations.literal: Third month, on yichou Japanese pirates raided Tongzhou and Taizhou; survivors entered the Qingzhou and Xuzhou region.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yichou, Japanese pirates struck Tongzhou and Taizhou, and surviving bands crossed into the Qingzhou and Xuzhou region.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，振畿內饑。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiaxu, famine relief was extended within the metropolitan region.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiaxu, famine relief was sent within the metropolitan region.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，倭犯嘉興，都司周應楨等戰死。

translations.literal: On yihai Japanese pirates raided Jiaxing; Commander Zhou Yingzhen and others died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Japanese pirates raided Jiaxing, and Commander Zhou Yingzhen and others were killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，陷崇明，知縣唐一岑死之。

translations.literal: On yiyou they took Chongming; Magistrate Tang Yicen died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou they overran Chongming, and Magistrate Tang Yicen died defending the county.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，倭掠蘇州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on renyin Japanese pirates plundered Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renyin, Japanese pirates plundered Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，南京兵部尚書張經總督軍務，討倭。

translations.literal: On dingsi Zhang Jing, Minister of War at Nanjing, was made supreme commander of military affairs to campaign against the Japanese pirates.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Zhang Jing, minister of war at Nanjing, was made supreme commander of military affairs to campaign against the Japanese pirates.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，俺答犯大同，總兵官岳懋戰死。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on guiyou Anda invaded Datong; Regional Commander Yue Mao died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiyou, Anda invaded Datong, and Regional Commander Yue Mao was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 己丑，侍郎陳儒振大同軍士。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen: Yan Ne, Minister of Personnel, and Li Chunfang, Minister of Rites, were both concurrently made Grand Secretaries of the Wuying Hall and joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengchen, Yan Ne, minister of personnel, and Li Chunfang, minister of rites, were also made grand secretaries of the Wuying Hall and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 壬午，俺答犯肅州，總兵官劉承業禦卻之。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Anda invaded Suzhou; Regional Commander Liu Chengye repelled him.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Anda invaded Suzhou and Regional Commander Liu Chengye drove him back.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，芝生睿宗原廟柱，告廟受賀，遂建玉芝宮。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiaxu: fungus grew on a pillar of the original temple of the Ruizong Emperor; the court reported to the ancestral temple and received congratulations; the Jade Fungus Palace was then built.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, sacred fungus appeared on a pillar of Emperor Ruizong's original temple; the court announced it at the ancestral temple, received congratulations, and then built the Jade Fungus Palace.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬午，獲仙藥於御座，告廟。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day renwu: an elixir was obtained at the imperial throne; the court reported to the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on renwu, an elixir was found at the imperial throne and the court reported to the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸卯，嚴訥致仕。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day guimao: Yan Ne retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on guimao, Yan Ne retired from office.

sentences.zh: 戊申，奉安獻皇帝、後神主于玉芝宮。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the spirit tablets of Emperor Xian and the Empress were enshrined in the Jade Fungus Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the spirit tablets of Emperor Xian and the Empress were installed in the Jade Fungus Palace.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：世宗禦極之初，力除一切弊政，天下翕然稱治。

translations.literal: Appraisal: At the beginning of Shizong's accession, he energetically eliminated all corrupt practices, and the realm united in acclaiming good governance.
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: At the start of Shizong's reign he energetically swept away corrupt practices, and the realm united in praising good governance.

sentences.zh: 顧迭議大禮，輿論沸騰，幸臣假託，尋興大獄。

translations.literal: Yet when the Great Rites controversy arose repeatedly, public opinion boiled over; favored ministers seized the occasion for their own ends, and soon great prosecutions followed.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when the Great Rites controversy erupted again and again, public opinion boiled over with it; favored ministers seized the moment, and soon great prosecutions followed.

sentences.zh: 夫天性至情，君親大義，追尊立廟，禮亦宜之；

translations.literal: Human nature cherishes deepest feeling; the duty owed to ruler and parent is a great moral principle—to posthumously honor one's father and establish a temple for him was also ritually fitting;
translations.idiomatic: Natural feeling runs deepest; the duty owed to ruler and parent is a great moral principle—to posthumously honor one's father and establish a temple for him was ritually fitting as well;

sentences.zh: 然升祔太廟，而躋于武宗之上，不已過乎！

translations.literal: Yet to enshrine him alongside the ancestors in the Imperial Ancestral Temple and place him above Emperor Wuzong—was that not excessive?
translations.idiomatic: Yet to install him in the Imperial Ancestral Temple and place him above Emperor Wuzong—was that not going too far?

sentences.zh: 若其時紛紜多故，將疲于邊，賊訌於內，而崇尚道教，享祀弗經，營建繁興，府藏告匱，百餘年富庶治平之業，因以漸替。

translations.literal: As for his time, affairs were tangled and numerous; armies were exhausted on the frontier, rebels rose within, yet he exalted Daoism, sacrificed in unorthodox rites, launched construction on all sides, and the treasury was depleted—a century and more of prosperity and good order thus gradually declined.
translations.idiomatic: As for his reign, affairs proliferated without end; armies were worn down on the frontier and rebellion broke out within, even as he exalted Daoism, conducted irregular sacrifices, and launched construction on every side until the treasury was empty—more than a century's work of prosperity and order thus ebbed away.

sentences.zh: 雖剪剔權奸，威柄在禦，要亦中材之主也矣。

translations.literal: Although he uprooted powerful schemers and kept authority in his own hands, on the whole he was only a ruler of moderate talent.
translations.idiomatic: Although he cut down powerful schemers and kept authority firmly in his own hands, on the whole he was a ruler of only moderate gifts.
